clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Clerk Daltry searches the town records for Stalvan Mistmantle. The oldest entry points west to the abandoned schoolhouse in Moonbrook, Westfall, where the search for Stalvan’s past begins.

After your inquiries in Darkshire, Clerk Daltry searches the town registry for Stalvan Mistmantle. The ledger has not been updated in years, and it gives Stalvan’s last known home as the schoolhouse in Moonbrook, far to the west. Daltry treats the old address as routine record keeping. He asks you to look into it and bring back any records that might bring Darkshire’s dusty archives up to date.

The trail leads from Duskwood into Westfall, where Defias Brotherhood outlaws hold Moonbrook. The town was once a thriving farming settlement. Near its center stands the abandoned schoolhouse, quiet amid the bandit occupation. Inside, an old footlocker holds the first clear clues to Stalvan’s former life as an educator. A restless sorrow also lingers around the chest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Stalvan, eh? Let me check the town registry.
Stalvan...Stalvan...let's see. Ah, here we go! I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle. The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. My, talk about outdated!
Do me a favor will you, friend? If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow. I like to keep the records clean.
